item.title: guix: 1.5.0 -> 1.5.0-unstable-2026-08-23
item.description:

Fix pending CVEs noted in a recent Guix blog post.

Link: https://guix.gnu.org/en/blog/2026/guix-substitute-pull-vulnerabilities/

Guix doesn’t make patch releases; we have addressed previous vulnerabilities by updating to a recent commit on master.
